heading.title: Procedure in Relation to Children in Conflict with Law

article.title: Proceeding under Chapter VIII of the Code of Criminal Procedure not to apply against child.
article.content:
22Proceeding under Chapter VIII of the Code of Criminal Procedure not to apply against child.

Section 22  ·  Chapter IV  ·  page 19 of the Act
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (2 of 1974), or any preventive detention law for the time being in force, no proceeding shall be instituted and no order shall be passed against any child under Chapter VIII of the said Code.
